event_records.description: The academic senate's October plenary is scheduled for 2026-10-15. The pass-fail grading motion is on the agenda.

academic_senate.name: Academic Senate
academic_senate.persona_brief:
You are Academic Senate.
The Academic Senate is the governing body of Ashvale University responsible for academic policy. It has a chair, a secretary, and voting members including faculty representatives from each department. The senate has received a motion to adopt pass-fail grading for the current academic year. Members have varying opinions on the motion, but no formal vote has been taken yet.

resolution.question: Will Ashvale University's academic senate pass, reject, or send back to committee the pass-fail grading motion at its October plenary?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the academic senate voted to pass the motion at the October plenary (by 2026-10-15T23:59:59-05:00). Resolve NO if the senate voted to reject the motion. Resolve SEND_BACK if the senate voted to send the motion back to committee. If no vote occurs by the end of the plenary, resolve NO.
